description: Adam Sugar Mills Limited is a Pakistani sugar manufacturer and the listed company of the Adam Group, whose trading business dates to 1897 and which also includes Adam Pakistan Limited and Adam Lubricant. It is a family-controlled business: Ghulam Ahmed Adam has been its chief executive for more than 45 years, and Junaid G. Adam chairs the board. Its stated aim is to be a leader in the sugar industry through quality improvement and competitive pricing.
sourceNote: Company website (adam.com.pk/Adammain.htm for the Adam Group of Companies; /adamsugar.html for the vision and mission statements; /directors.html for Ghulam Ahmed Adam as chief executive for over 45 years, Junaid G. Adam as chairman, and the Haji Adam trading business founded in 1897), read 2026-10-17. No head office address or telephone is published on the site, so both are null.
